title: BulkImportJobPostingInput
description: A single job posting entry in the NDJSON stream

url.description: The URL of the job posting to parse

career_site_label.description: Label of the career site to group this posting under. Career sites are automatically created if they do not exist.

job_code.description: Optional job code to associate with the posting

location.description: The location of the job. When omitted, existing location is preserved. Pass null to explicitly clear.
